key_impacts: Storm surge flooding exceeded New York City’s 100-year floodplain by 53% citywide.
About 8,500,000 customers lost power at peak.
Two New Jersey refineries were shut, cutting 26.3% of 1,170,200 BPD regional capacity.
Three health care facilities in Manhattan and Brooklyn evacuated all patients due to power outages.
More than 200 fatalities occurred along Sandy’s track.
evidence_snippets: In late October 2012, Hurricane Sandy caused enormous damages along the northeastern coast of the United States.
Its arrival on the evening of October 29 generated a storm surge ... flooding that exceeded the 100-year floodplain boundaries by 53% citywide.
Approximately 8,500,000 customers lost power at peak during Sandy.
